parsed.why: Patterned lethal violence against trans women (2024, 2025, 2026 wave), likely impunity, hostile religious-court ruling, ward-placement death, police ridicule and Islamist non-state threat outweigh the protective statute; no state persecution or border screening documented.

State framing (2025 defense decree) plus surging vigilante mob attacks, villa raids, Aceh caning, death-in-custody of a trans traveler with extortion allegation, new criminalizing penal code and pathologization: state-tolerated targeting at scale.

Criminalisation actively enforced (Dec 2024 conviction) with uncertain penalty, no recognition or organisations, weak rule of law — but episodic, case-driven enforcement, no documented trans-specific violence, and 2023 records of no prosecutions and no police-tolerated violence.

Hate-crime law with a real 20-year conviction for killing a trans woman signals working recourse, but birth-sex custody abuse in raids, police non-cooperation, gang extortion and 85% public approval of violence against trans people dominate the exposure.

Universal border exposure: airport genital X-ray checks, repeated entry refusals and a trans visitor's imprisonment with head-shaving and destroyed hormones; gender-nonconformity offence, torture in detention, no organisations or recognition. State is the perpetrator.
